visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark hair tied back and a green hair clip is sitting at a desk, holding a smartphone. She is wearing a white, semi-sheer lace top with a floral patterned bodice. She looks at the phone with a distressed facial expression. The background includes a black metal shelf with white cables and a dark blue box. (2) Close-up of the smartphone screen displaying a chat interface with a yellow cartoon dog sticker. Fingers are visible tapping rapidly on the on-screen keyboard. (3) The woman holds the phone away from her face, looking up with her mouth wide open as if shouting in frustration. (4) The scene shifts to the woman sitting in a black and red gaming chair in front of a computer. She is typing aggressively on a mechanical keyboard placed on a League of Legends branded mousepad. (5) Close-up of a computer monitor showing a text document written in Traditional Chinese regarding the Galaxy S25 smartphone. (6) The woman leans over the keyboard, hitting it with both hands in an exaggerated, comedic show of anger and frustration, before returning to typing.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-pitched female voice exclaims 'Ah! 打錯字了' with sharp intensity. Behind the voice, a jaunty, synthesized electronic BGM with a steady 4/4 beat plays. Short, crisp clicking sounds consistent with phone keyboard taps are heard. (2) A rapid, machine-gun-like percussive sound effect triggers, representing the backspace key being held down. The female voice lets out a long, strained vocalization of 'Hoyo!' with a falling pitch contour, indicating extreme frustration. The comedic BGM continues unabated. (3) The acoustic environment shifts to rhythmic, mechanical keyboard clacks. The BGM remains at a consistent volume. (4) A loud, dull thudding sound occurs as if a surface is being struck. This is followed by another high-pitched, exaggerated groan of 'Oh!' from the speaker, blending into the energetic background track.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a 'POV' (Point of View) comedic format to humorously exaggerate the universal frustration of making typos while texting or typing long documents. It relies on the creator's expressive facial movements and loud vocal groans, synchronized with rapid sound effects, to resonate with viewers who have experienced the annoyance of having to delete and re-type text.
